name: upstash-ratelimit
description: Connectionless HTTP-based rate limiting for Serverless, Cloudflare Workers, and Next.js Edge Middleware.
author: Awesome API Skills Team
pitfalls: Instantiating new Ratelimit() inside the request handler on every call (breaks ephemeral in-memory block cache)
Ignoring the pending promise when analytics: true is enabled in serverless edge functions (pass context.waitUntil(pending))
Using TCP ioredis client instead of HTTP @upstash/redis client in Edge runtimes
checklist: Ratelimit instance initialized outside the request handler for ephemeral cache reuse
Redis.fromEnv() used with UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL and UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN
Rate limit headers (X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining) attached to 429 responses
